name: spelling-creator-hub
description: Author and publish spelling lessons to the Spelling Creator hub from your AI assistant.
long_description: Connects your AI assistant to the Spelling Creator hub so it can compose and publish spelling lessons for you. You describe the lesson; the assistant builds it (reading passages with ALL-CAPS spelling words, explicit word lists, and quiz questions) and saves it to the hub through the same API the web app uses — with all the usual validation and author attribution. Lessons default to private drafts; publish them when you're ready. Requires a Supabase refresh token (run the bundled `login` helper, or copy one from the web app) and a display name set on your account.

supabase_refresh_token.title: Supabase refresh token
supabase_refresh_token.description: Your hub sign-in token. Get one by running the bundled `login` helper, or copy `refresh_token` from the web app's sb-…-auth-token localStorage entry. Long-lived: it's refreshed automatically.

api_url.title: Hub API URL
api_url.description: The Spelling Creator API to publish to. Leave as the default unless you run your own instance.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Confirm the session is valid and show the publishing display name.

tools.name: create_lesson
tools.description: Build and save a new lesson (a private draft by default).

tools.name: create_lesson_file
tools.description: Build an importable lesson file offline, with no account or network.

tools.name: update_lesson
tools.description: Replace the title and content of a lesson you authored.

tools.name: patch_lesson
tools.description: Edit a lesson with a small list of id-addressed operations.

tools.name: fork_lesson
tools.description: Copy a lesson into a private draft of your own, keeping its version history.

tools.name: propose_changes
tools.description: Offer a fork's changes back to the original lesson, for a human to review and merge.

tools.name: list_lesson_proposals
tools.description: List the proposals against a lesson, and whether yours have been merged.

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: Fetch one lesson including its full content document.

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search Wikimedia Commons for freely-licensed images to illustrate a lesson.

tools.name: add_image
tools.description: Download a Wikimedia Commons image and insert it into a lesson you authored.

tools.name: list_my_lessons
tools.description: List your own lessons (drafts and published).

tools.name: list_hub_lessons
tools.description: Browse published lessons on the public hub.

tools.name: set_lesson_published
tools.description: Publish or unpublish a lesson without changing its content.

tools.name: delete_lesson
tools.description: Permanently delete a lesson you authored.
